entities.name: Bilbo Baggins
entities.description: A Hobbit who travels with Thorin's Dwarves as their burglar. He finds a turning point in his career in the dark, kills a spider with his sting, and returns home after he was presumed dead.

entities.name: Thorin Oakenshield
entities.description: A Dwarf leader who leads the journey toward the Lonely Mountain. He calls on his kinsfolk and speaks of going to the halls of waiting beside his fathers.

entities.name: Gandalf
entities.description: A Wizard who helps his friends in tight corners and guides the Dwarves and Bilbo. He is Radagast's cousin.

entities.name: Beorn
entities.description: A reluctant host who keeps dogs and fences. He has fifteen strangers sitting in his porch.

entities.name: Balin
entities.description: A Dwarf of the Company who knew the ravens of the rocks as a Dwarf-lad.

entities.name: Bofur
entities.description: A Dwarf who was left behind with Bombur to guard the ponies.

entities.name: Bombur
entities.description: A Dwarf who fell fast asleep in the forest and later tried to recapture the beautiful dreams he had there.

entities.name: Kíli
entities.description: A Dwarf of the Company who marvels at the torches, fires and harps of the Elves.

entities.name: Dáin
entities.description: Lord of the Dwarves of the Iron Hills. He answered Thorin's urgent plea.

entities.name: Bard
entities.description: A grim-voiced man of Lake-town who slew the Dragon. Afterward he took the lead in governing and protecting the people.

entities.name: Smaug
entities.description: The Dragon of the Lonely Mountain, who attacked Lake-town and met his end there.

entities.name: Thranduil
entities.description: The Elvenking, who sits on a carven wooden chair in a great hall of stone pillars. He threatens to imprison the Dwarves.

entities.name: Gollum
entities.description: A creature who rows silently on the underground lake and mourns his lost 'precious'.

entities.name: The Great Goblin
entities.description: Leader of the Goblins. He threatened Thorin and was killed by the Company.

entities.name: Bolg of the North
entities.description: A Goblin leader whose coming Gandalf warns of.

entities.name: Elrond
entities.description: He read Thrór's Map and found the moon-letters on it.

entities.name: Radagast
entities.description: A Wizard and Gandalf's cousin, who lives near the southern borders of Mirkwood.

entities.name: Galion
entities.description: The Elvenking's butler, found by the guards with his head on a jug.

entities.name: Grubb, Grubb, and Burrowes
entities.description: Three lawyers who auctioned Bilbo's belongings when he was presumed dead.

entities.name: The Sackville-Bagginses
entities.description: Hobbits who were slow to accept that Bilbo was not dead.

entities.name: Took clan
entities.description: A Hobbit clan whose members occasionally went on adventures.

entities.name: The Company
entities.description: Thorin's band of Dwarves and Bilbo. They killed the Great Goblin.

entities.name: Dwarves
entities.description: A long-lived folk who carry heavy burdens and forge lasting blades.

entities.name: Dwarves of the Iron Hills
entities.description: Dáin's Dwarves, clad in steel mail. They charged into the battle crying 'Moria!'

entities.name: Goblins
entities.description: Clever and cruel mountain-dwellers who make instruments of torture.

entities.name: Wargs
entities.description: Evil wolves who live over the Edge of the Wild and aid the Goblins.

entities.name: Eagles
entities.description: Ancient, proud and noble birds of the northern mountains, hated and feared by Goblins.

entities.name: The Lord of the Eagles
entities.description: The chief of the Eagles.

entities.name: Wood-Elves
entities.description: Elves of Mirkwood who distrust strangers and love the stars.

entities.name: Stone-giants
entities.description: Giants who hurl rocks at one another for a game.

entities.name: Old Tomnoddy
entities.description: Taunting names Bilbo shouts at the spiders of Mirkwood.

entities.name: Were-worms
entities.description: Wild creatures of the Last Desert, named in an expression for an impossible task.

entities.name: Mirkwood
entities.description: The greatest of the forests of the northern world.

entities.name: Lake-town
entities.description: A town built on the surface of the Long Lake, under the shadow of the Dragon-mountain.

entities.name: Long Lake
entities.description: The lake on which Lake-town is built.

entities.name: Dale
entities.description: A once rich and prosperous northern city that may reclaim its glory.

entities.name: Lonely Mountain
entities.description: The Dragon's mountain, the goal of Thorin's journey.

entities.name: Iron Hills
entities.description: Hills providing quality iron, home to Dáin's folk.

entities.name: Goblin-town
entities.description: The Goblins' stuffy, tangled tunnels in the heart of the mountain.

entities.name: Misty Mountains
entities.description: Mountains whose foothills are home to Wargs and Goblins.

entities.name: Edge of the Wild
entities.description: A borderland where the evil wolf packs hunt and den.

entities.name: The Carrock
entities.description: A rock in the river where the bear tracks disappeared.

entities.name: Last Desert
entities.description: Where the wild Were-worms live.

entities.name: Moria
entities.description: A name the Dwarves of the Iron Hills cry out in battle.

entities.name: Thrór's Map
entities.description: A map bearing moon-letters about the keyhole and Durin's Day.

entities.name: Key to the Side-Door
entities.description: A key that went with the map.

entities.name: Glamdring
entities.description: A sword that flashes in its own light.

entities.name: Sting
entities.description: Bilbo's blade, which he used to kill a spider.

entities.name: Durin's Day
entities.description: A day whose last light of the setting sun will shine upon the keyhole.

events.summary: Thorin announces the Company's long journey, from which some of them may never return.
events.quote: We shall soon, before the break of day, start on our long journey—a journey from which some of us, or perhaps all of us, may never return.

events.summary: Bilbo, Thorin and the Dwarves kill the Great Goblin and many other Goblins.
events.quote: The Company had lost a great deal, but they had killed the Great Goblin and many others besides.

events.summary: Bilbo's hand meets the turning point of his career in the dark beneath the mountains.
events.quote: until his hand met what would be the real turning point in his career.

events.summary: Gandalf's pinecones burst into sparks in the circle of wolves.
events.quote: The pinecones burst on the ground in the middle of the circle of wolves and went off in colored sparks and smoke.

events.summary: Beorn hosts fifteen strangers on his porch.
events.quote: Now he had got fifteen strangers sitting in his porch!

events.summary: Gandalf tells Beorn about his cousin Radagast.
events.quote: "Perhaps you have heard of my good cousin Radagast who lives near the southern borders of Mirkwood?" Gandalf asked.

events.summary: The Company sets out on the path to Mirkwood.
events.quote: The sun had only just turned west when they started on the path to Mirkwood

events.summary: Bilbo kills a spider with Sting.
events.quote: Before the spider knew what was happening, it felt Bilbo's sting and rolled off the branch, dead.

events.summary: The Elvenking threatens to imprison the Dwarves until they explain themselves.
events.quote: I will keep you all in prison until you have learned sense and manners!

events.summary: The guards wake to find their prisoners escaped.
events.quote: The guards were decidedly less than pleased, upon waking, to find their prisoners escaped.

events.summary: Three boats leave Lake-town carrying the Dwarves and Bilbo.
events.quote: three large boats left Lake-town, laden with rowers, Dwarves, a Hobbit, and hope.

events.summary: Smaug attacks the mountainsides with flame as the Dwarves flee to the tunnel.
events.quote: Smaug came hurtling from the north, licking the mountainsides with flame

events.summary: Bard, slayer of the Dragon, kills Smaug, and Lake-town is destroyed.
events.quote: And that was the end of Smaug and Esgaroth.

events.summary: After Smaug's fall, Bard takes up governing and protecting the people.
events.quote: After Smaug fell, Bard took the lead with the hard task of governing and protecting the people.

events.summary: Dáin answers Thorin's plea and arms his smiths.
events.quote: Dáin heard Thorin's urgent plea and ordered his smiths to fetch their strongest axes and mattocks.

events.summary: Gandalf warns that Bolg of the North is coming.
events.quote: "Alas! Bolg of the North is coming!" —Gandalf

events.summary: The Dwarves of the Iron Hills charge into battle.
events.quote: With cries of "Moria!" and "Dáin, Dáin!" the Dwarves of the Iron Hills plunged in.

events.summary: Thorin speaks of going to the halls of waiting beside his fathers.
events.quote: I go now to the halls of waiting to sit beside my fathers, until the world is renewed.

events.summary: Bilbo's belongings are auctioned while he is presumed dead.
events.quote: Since Bilbo was presumed dead, his belongings were auctioned by three of the town's best lawyers: Messrs. Grubb, Grubb, and Burrowes.
